title: A message from school
instructions: Okul müdürü velilere kısa bir sesli mesaj bırakıyor. Kısa ama her bilgi önemli. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: head
script.text: Hello, this is Mrs Clark from Hill School.

script.speaker: head
script.text: School is closed tomorrow because there's no water.

script.speaker: head
script.text: The trip to the zoo is now on Wednesday, not Monday.

script.speaker: head
script.text: Children don't need money, but they need a packed lunch.

script.speaker: head
script.text: The bus leaves at eight fifteen. Thank you.

questions.prompt: Why is the school closed tomorrow?
questions.feedback: Okul yarın kapalı çünkü su yok (there's no water).

questions.prompt: Where are the children going on the trip?

questions.feedback: Gezi artık çarşamba (now on Wednesday), pazartesi değil.

questions.prompt: What do the children need for the trip?
questions.feedback: Paraya gerek yok (don't need money) ama yanlarında yemek (packed lunch) olmalı.
questions.evidence: Children don't need money, but they need a packed lunch.

questions.prompt: What time does the bus leave?
questions.feedback: Otobüs sekizi on beş geçe (eight fifteen) kalkıyor. "Fifteen" ile "fifty" karışmasın.
questions.evidence: The bus leaves at eight fifteen.
